decisions.rationale: Refers to one specific disease, a deficiency of the sixth complement component (C6 deficiency), which is a single defined condition rather than a family of diseases.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 6 (C7 deficiency is a Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: Meningococcal meningitis is a single, specific infectious disease with its own definition and no further categorization needed.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 13 (Acute meningococcal pericarditis as a separate disease concept)

decisions.rationale: 'haemostasis abnormality' is a very general term describing abnormalities in general, not a specific disease, so it is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (Do not annotate general terms such as 'abnormalities'); Examples 6 (general terms are too general)

decisions.rationale: 'complete C6 deficiency' names one specific form of disease (complete C6 deficiency), so the whole phrase is the minimum necessary specific span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span, prefer whole specific phrase); Examples 15 (particular form of disease)

decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (Annotate duplicate mentions); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease)
